The details

What to know

Anything marked pending is pending because the school has not said. Each card fills in the day WHS publishes it.

The ceremony

Date
May 21, 2027
Time
5:00 PM CT
Venue
Weiss Field

Rehearsal is May 19 at 10:00 AM at Brookside Campus.

Source: WHS calendar

Tickets

Most WHS ceremonies have used guest tickets. How many each graduate gets, how they are distributed, and whether extras are available is decided by the school each year.

Outstanding fees can hold tickets. If you think you owe anything, clear it with the main office early.

Pending WHS: ticket counts and pickup details

Arrival and seating

Graduates arrive well before guests to line up. Guests are seated first come, first served unless WHS says otherwise. Plan for the walk from parking.

Pending WHS: graduate report time and guest gate-opening time

Dress and regalia

Cap, gown, and any cords or stoles issued by WHS are worn over your own outfit. Comfortable shoes you can walk a field or a ramp in. Decorated caps depend on the school’s policy for the year.

Pending WHS: dress code and cap-decoration policy

Cap and gown ordering

WHS announces the vendor, the order window, and the cost. This site links only to the official order page once it exists. Be suspicious of any other link claiming to sell WHS regalia.

Pending WHS: vendor, deadline, and price

Parking and accessibility

Parking fills fast at any ceremony. Carpool, arrive early, and expect a walk.

Accessible seating and parking are normally available for guests who need them. Ask the main office ahead of time so it can be arranged.

Pending WHS: parking directions and accessible-seating instructions

Livestream

For family who cannot be there in person. If WHS or the district streams the ceremony, the link will be here and on the event page before the day.

Pending WHS: whether there is a livestream and where to watch

Rehearsal

Rehearsal is usually required to walk. It is where you learn your seat, your row, and how to not trip on the ramp. Treat it as mandatory until told otherwise.

May 19 at 10:00 AM · Brookside Campus

Requirements to walk

Walking means finishing: credits, required courses, state assessments, and cleared fees and obligations. Your counselor can confirm exactly where you stand.

Do this this semester, not in May. Graduation requirements on the Resources page.
